plugins.name: diagramforge
plugins.description: Business-formal animated diagrams: 27 layouts (all 14 UML types, C4, BPMN, gantt, orgchart, mindmap, timeline, fishbone, panorama/swimlane/graph/grid), four formal styles + custom brand themes, PNG/GIF/MP4/SVG/HTML/Excalidraw/Lottie output, Mermaid and draw.io import.
